about: The collecta of the formulary “Quinquagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, graciously hear our prayers and, having loosed us from the bonds of sins, preserve us from all adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
